note: Views URL Path Arguments provides two Views plugins under the single id 'views_url_path': an argument_default ('Entity ID converted from URL path alias') and an argument_validator ('Entity ID from URL path alias'), each with options segments (slash-free string) and provide_static_segments (bool). No configure route, settings form, permission, Drush, or config entity; all state lives inside a view config entity's display arguments. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real view config: introspection reads back default_argument_type/segments on a seeded view; execution configures a Content: ID contextual filter to use the default plugin (default_argument_type) or the validator (validate.type) with segments=catalog, verified against the live views.view config.

evals.prompt: In Drupal, I want a view's contextual filter to accept a URL path alias in the address and resolve it to the entity ID, using the views_url_path_arguments module. Which Views plugin id do I select on the contextual filter (for 'Provide default value' or validation)?
evals.expected_output: Select the 'views_url_path' plugin: as the default-value plugin ('Entity ID converted from URL path alias', default_argument_type=views_url_path) or as the validator ('Entity ID from URL path alias', validate.type=views_url_path). It looks the last URL segment up as a path alias via path_alias.repository and returns the entity ID.

evals.prompt: The views_url_path_arguments Views argument plugin lets me prefix the alias with a fixed URL segment before it is resolved. Which two configuration options control that?
evals.expected_output: provide_static_segments (a boolean checkbox) turns the prefix on, and segments (a string without leading/trailing slashes, e.g. 'blog') is the prefix that gets prepended to the alias before lookup.

evals.prompt: How does the views_url_path_arguments module turn a URL path alias into an entity ID at runtime, and which core module/service does it rely on?
evals.expected_output: It depends on the core path_alias (and views) module. At runtime it takes the last raw route parameter and, if not already numeric, looks it up as a path alias via the path_alias.repository service (lookupByAlias) for the current URL language, returning the entity ID from the resolved system path. Numeric arguments pass through unchanged.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a view with machine id 'vupa_intro_view' that has a Content: ID contextual filter. Inspect the live view configuration and state which Views argument-default plugin provides that contextual filter's default value.
evals.expected_output: Its contextual filter (arguments.nid) has default_argument_type: views_url_path (the views_url_path_arguments default plugin, 'Entity ID converted from URL path alias').

evals.prompt: The view 'vupa_intro_view' on this site uses the views_url_path argument-default plugin on its Content: ID contextual filter, configured with a static URL segment prefix. Inspect the live view configuration and give the value of the 'segments' option.
evals.expected_output: segments is 'reports' (default_argument_options.segments: reports, provide_static_segments: true) in vupa_intro_view's arguments.nid.

evals.prompt: The view with machine id 'vupa_task_view' on this site has a Content: ID contextual filter. Using the views_url_path_arguments module, configure that contextual filter so that when no argument is present the default value is derived from the URL path alias ('Entity ID converted from URL path alias'), with a static URL segment prefix of 'catalog'. Apply the change to the live view.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.vupa_task_view the arguments.nid component has default_argument_type: views_url_path and default_argument_options: {segments: catalog, provide_static_segments: true}.

evals.prompt: The view with machine id 'vupa_task_view' on this site has a Content: ID contextual filter. Using the views_url_path_arguments module, add validation to that contextual filter so the incoming argument is treated as a URL path alias and converted to an entity ID ('Entity ID from URL path alias'), configured with a static URL segment prefix of 'catalog'. Apply the change to the live view.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.vupa_task_view the arguments.nid component has validate.type: views_url_path with validate.options.views_url_path.segments: catalog (provide_static_segments: true).
